text: Allianz SE, the Munich-based insurance group whose shares trade in Frankfurt (DAX), reports that its share register held 901,740 shareholders and that Allianz shares are held 100% in free float - no state, foundation or controlling shareholder is named.
short: Allianz SE shares are held 100% in free float, no controlling owner.

source.name: Allianz SE Investor Relations, Shareholder structure (Archived 29 Jan 2023, Wayback Machine)
source.note: The live allianz.com pages sit behind a script challenge (HTTP 403 to scripts); quote verified on the Internet Archive snapshot of Allianz's own shareholder-structure page.
source.quote: On December 31, 2022 the share register of Allianz SE contained 901,740 shareholders. Allianz shares are held 100% in free float.
